basic_info.description: Prime Anza Vista! Spectacular panoramic views from three floors. Upon entering this beautifully remodeled home you are mesmerized by the large windows framing the unobstructed views of the SF skyline, Transamerica Pyramid bldg, Salesforce Tower, St. Mary's Cathedral & SF City Hall, the bay and much more! From the ships on the bay to Alta Plaza Park in Pacific Heights it is spectacular. The breathtaking views are enjoyed from the foyer, living room, dining room, kitchen, & 2 primary en-suite bdrms. Off the dining room, the lg view walk-out deck with gas hook-up for a barbecue is a perfect setting for outdoor dining or stargazing. The hallmarks of this beautiful home include 2 walk-out view decks, a lovely walk-out garden, a gorgeous remodeled view kitchen with skylight and breakfast area. The primary en-suite with fireplace encompasses the entire top floor showcasing the unobstructed panoramic views. Beautiful architectural detailing includes hardwood floors, parquet floors, plaster moldings, lovely staircase, 2 fireplaces & double-paned windows. 4 bedrooms and office/media room with separate entrance. The 2 car garage is pristine. Excellent storage, fabulous neighborhood, premier location, walking distance to shopping, great restaurants, top schools & transportation.
